texts.mic.6.13: то и Я неисцельно поражу тебя опустошением за грехи твои.
texts.mic.6.14: Ты будешь есть, и не будешь сыт; пустота будет внутри тебя; будешь хранить, но не убережешь, а что сбережешь, то предам мечу.
texts.mic.6.15: Будешь сеять, а жать не будешь; будешь давить оливки, и не будешь умащаться елеем; выжмешь виноградный сок, а вина пить не будешь.
texts.mic.6.16: Сохранились у вас обычаи Амврия и все дела дома Ахавова, и вы поступаете по советам их; и предам Я тебя опустошению и жителей твоих посмеянию, и вы понесете поругание народа Моего.
texts.mic.7.1: Горе мне! ибо со мною теперь — как по собрании летних плодов, как по уборке винограда: ни одной ягоды для еды, ни спелого плода, которого желает душа моя.
texts.mic.7.2: Не стало милосердых на земле, нет правдивых между людьми; все строят ковы, чтобы проливать кровь; каждый ставит брату своему сеть.
texts.mic.7.3: Руки их обращены к тому, чтобы уметь делать зло; начальник требует подарков, и судья судит за взятки, а вельможи высказывают злые хотения души своей и извращают дело.
texts.mic.7.4: Лучший из них — как терн, и справедливый — хуже колючей изгороди, день провозвестников Твоих, посещение Твое наступает; ныне постигнет их смятение.
texts.mic.7.5: Не верьте другу, не полагайтесь на приятеля; от лежащей на лоне твоем стереги двери уст твоих.
texts.mic.7.6: Ибо сын позорит отца, дочь восстает против матери, невестка — против свекрови своей; враги человеку — домашние его.
texts.mic.7.7: А я буду взирать на Господа, уповать на Бога спасения моего: Бог мой услышит меня.
texts.mic.7.8: Не радуйся ради меня, неприятельница моя! хотя я упал, но встану; хотя я во мраке, но Господь свет для меня.
texts.mic.7.9: Гнев Господень я буду нести, потому что согрешил пред Ним, доколе Он не решит дела моего и не совершит суда надо мною; тогда Он выведет меня на свет, и я увижу правду Его.
texts.mic.7.10: И увидит это неприятельница моя и стыд покроет ее, говорившую мне: "где Господь Бог твой?" Насмотрятся на нее глаза мои, как она будет попираема подобно грязи на улицах.
texts.mic.7.11: В день сооружения стен твоих, в этот день отдалится определение.
texts.mic.7.12: В тот день придут к тебе из Ассирии и городов Египетских, и от Египта до реки Евфрата, и от моря до моря, и от горы до горы.
texts.mic.7.13: А земля та будет пустынею за вину жителей ее, за плоды деяний их.
texts.mic.7.14: Паси народ Твой жезлом Твоим, овец наследия Твоего, обитающих уединенно в лесу среди Кармила; да пасутся они на Васане и Галааде, как во дни древние!
texts.mic.7.15: Как во дни исхода твоего из земли Египетской, явлю ему дивные дела.
texts.mic.7.16: Увидят это народы и устыдятся при всем могуществе своем; положат руку на уста, уши их сделаются глухими;
texts.mic.7.17: будут лизать прах как змея, как черви земные выползут они из укреплений своих; устрашатся Господа Бога нашего и убоятся Тебя.
texts.mic.7.18: Кто Бог, как Ты, прощающий беззаконие и не вменяющий преступления остатку наследия Твоего? не вечно гневается Он, потому что любит миловать.
texts.mic.7.19: Он опять умилосердится над нами, изгладит беззакония наши. Ты ввергнешь в пучину морскую все грехи наши.
texts.mic.7.20: Ты явишь верность Иакову, милость Аврааму, которую с клятвою обещал отцам нашим от дней первых.

texts.mic.1.1: Palavra do Senhor, que veiu a Miqueas, morasthita, nos dias de Jothão, Achaz e Ezequias, reis de Judah, a qual elle viu sobre Samaria e Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.2: Ouvi, todos os povos, attenta tu, terra, e a plenitude d’ella, e seja o Senhor Jehovah testemunha contra vós, o Senhor, desde o templo da sua sanctidade.
texts.mic.1.3: Porque eis que o Senhor sae do seu logar, e descerá, e pizará as alturas da terra.
texts.mic.1.4: E os montes debaixo d’elle se derreterão, e os valles se fenderão, como a cera diante do fogo, como as aguas que se precipitam n’um abysmo.
texts.mic.1.5: Tudo isto por causa da prevaricação de Jacob, e dos peccados da casa de Israel: quem é o auctor da rebellião de Jacob? não é Samaria? e quem o das alturas de Judah? não é Jerusalem?
texts.mic.1.6: Por isso farei de Samaria um montão de pedras do campo, uma terra de plantar vinhas, e farei rebolar as suas pedras no valle, e descobrirei os seus fundamentos.
texts.mic.1.7: E todas as suas imagens de esculptura serão esmiuçadas, e todos os seus salarios serão queimados pelo fogo, e de todos os seus idolos eu farei uma assolação, porque da paga de prostitutas os ajuntou, e para a paga de prostitutas voltarão.
texts.mic.1.8: Por isso lamentarei, e uivarei, andarei despojado e nú: farei lamentação como de dragões, e pranto como de abestruzes.
texts.mic.1.9: Porque a sua chaga é incuravel, porque chegou até Judah: estendeu-se até á porta do meu povo, até Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.10: Não o annuncieis em Gath, nem choreis muito: revolve-te no pó, na casa de Aphra.
texts.mic.1.11: Passa, ó moradora de Saphir, com nudez vergonhosa: a moradora de Zaanan não sae para fóra; o pranto de Beth-ezel receberá de vós a sua estancia.
texts.mic.1.12: Porque a moradora de Maroth teve dôr pelo bem; porque desceu do Senhor o mal até á porta de Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.13: Ata os animaes ligeiros ao carro, ó moradora de Lachis (esta é o principio do peccado para a filha de Sião), porque em ti se acharam as transgressões de Israel.
texts.mic.1.14: Por isso dá presentes a Moreshethgath: as casas de Achzib serão casas de mentira aos reis de Israel.
texts.mic.1.15: Ainda te trarei um herdeiro, ó moradora de Maresha: chegar-se-ha até Adullam, para gloria de Israel.
texts.mic.1.16: Faze-te calva, e tosquia-te, por causa dos filhos das tuas delicias: alarga a tua calva como a aguia, porque te foram levados captivos.
texts.mic.2.1: Ai d’aquelles que nas suas camas intentam a iniquidade, e obram o mal: á luz da alva o põem em obra, porque está no poder da sua mão!
texts.mic.2.2: E cobiçam campos, e os arrebatam, e casas, e as tomam: assim fazem violencia a um homem e á casa, a uma pessoa e á sua herança.
texts.mic.2.3: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor: Eis que intento mal contra esta geração, d’onde não tirareis os vossos pescoços, nem andareis tão altivos, porque o tempo será mau.
texts.mic.2.4: N’aquelle dia se levantará um proverbio sobre vós, e se pranteará pranto lastimoso, dizendo: Nós estamos inteiramente desolados! a porção do meu povo elle a troca! como me despoja! para nos tirar os nossos campos elle os reparte!
texts.mic.2.5: Portanto, não terás tu na congregação do Senhor quem lance o cordel pela sorte.
texts.mic.2.6: Não prophetizeis, os que prophetizam, não prophetizem d’este modo, que se não apartará a vergonha.
texts.mic.2.7: Ó vós que sois chamados a casa de Jacob, porventura se tem encurtado o Espirito do Senhor? são estas as suas obras? e não é assim que fazem bem as minhas palavras ao que anda rectamente?
texts.mic.2.8: Mas assim como fôra hontem, se levantou o meu povo por inimigo: de sobre a vestidura tirastes a capa d’aquelles que passavam seguros, como os que voltavam da guerra.
texts.mic.2.9: Lançaes fóra as mulheres do meu povo, da casa das suas delicias: dos seus meninos tirastes o meu louvor para sempre.
texts.mic.2.10: Levantae-vos, pois, e andae, porque não será esta terra o descanço; porquanto está contaminada, vos corromperá, e isso com grande corrupção.
texts.mic.2.11: Se houver algum que siga o seu espirito, e está mentindo falsamente, dizendo: Eu te prophetizarei de vinho e de bebida forte; far-se-ha então este tal o propheta d’este povo.
texts.mic.2.12: Certamente te ajuntarei todo inteiro, ó Jacob: certamente congregarei o restante de Israel: pôl-o-hei todo junto, como ovelhas de Bozra; como o rebanho no meio do seu curral, farão estrondo pela multidão dos homens.
texts.mic.2.13: Subirá diante d’elles o que romperá o caminho: elles romperão, e entrarão pela porta, e sairão por ella; e o rei irá adiante d’elles, e o Senhor á testa d’elles.
texts.mic.3.1: Mais disse eu: Ouvi agora vós, chefes de Jacob, e vós, principes da casa de Israel; porventura não é a vós que pertence saber o direito?
texts.mic.3.2: Que aborreceis o bem, e amaes o mal, que lhes arrancaes a pelle de cima d’elles, e a sua carne de cima dos seus ossos,
texts.mic.3.3: E que comeis a carne do meu povo, e lhes esfolaes a sua pelle, e lhes esmiuçaes os ossos, e os repartis como para a panella e como carne no meio do caldeirão.
texts.mic.3.4: Então clamarão ao Senhor, mas não os ouvirá, antes esconderá d’elles a sua face n’aquelle tempo, visto que elles fizeram mal com as suas obras.
texts.mic.3.5: Assim diz o Senhor contra os prophetas que fazem errar o meu povo, que mordem com os seus dentes, e clamam paz; mas contra aquelle que nada lhes mette na bocca preparam guerra.
texts.mic.3.6: Portanto, se vos fará noite por causa da prophecia, e vos serão trevas por causa da adivinhação, e se porá o sol sobre estes prophetas, e o dia sobre elles se ennegrecerá.
texts.mic.3.7: E os videntes se envergonharão, e os adivinhadores se confundirão; e todos juntos cobrirão o beiço superior, porque não haverá resposta de Deus.
texts.mic.3.8: Mas decerto eu sou cheio da força do Espirito do Senhor, e cheio de juizo e animo, para annunciar a Jacob a sua transgressão e a Israel o seu peccado.
texts.mic.3.9: Ouvi agora isto, vós, chefes da casa de Jacob, e vós, maioraes da casa de Israel, que abominaes o juizo e perverteis tudo o que é direito,
texts.mic.3.10: Edificando a Sião com sangue, e a Jerusalem com injustiça.
texts.mic.3.11: Os seus chefes dão as sentenças por presentes, e os seus sacerdotes ensinam por interesse, e os seus prophetas adivinham por dinheiro; e ainda se encostam ao Senhor, dizendo: Porventura não está o Senhor no meio de nós? nenhum mal nos sobrevirá.
texts.mic.3.12: Portanto, por causa de vós, Sião será lavrada como um campo, e Jerusalem se fará montões de pedras, e o monte d’esta casa alturas de bosque.
texts.mic.4.1: Mas no ultimo dos dias acontecerá que o monte da casa do Senhor será estabelecido no cume dos montes, e se elevará sobre os outeiros, e concorrerão a elle os povos.
texts.mic.4.2: E irão muitas nações, e dirão: Vinde, e subamos ao monte do Senhor, e á casa do Deus de Jacob, para que nos ensine os seus caminhos, e nós andemos pelas suas veredas; porque de Sião sairá a lei, e a palavra do Senhor de Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.3: E julgará entre muitos povos, e castigará poderosas nações até mui longe, e converterão as suas espadas em enxadas, e as suas lanças em foices: uma nação contra outra nação não levantará a espada, nem aprenderão mais a guerra.
texts.mic.4.4: Mas assentar-se-hão, cada um debaixo da sua videira, e debaixo da sua figueira, e não haverá quem os espante, porque a bocca do Senhor dos Exercitos o fallou.
texts.mic.4.5: Porque todos os povos andarão, cada um no nome do seu deus; mas nós andaremos no nome do Senhor nosso Deus, eternamente e para sempre.
texts.mic.4.6: N’aquelle dia, diz o Senhor, congregarei a que coxeava, e recolherei a que eu tinha expulsado, e a que eu tinha maltratado.
texts.mic.4.7: E da que coxeava farei um resto, e da que estava rejeitada longe uma nação poderosa; e o Senhor reinará sobre elles no monte de Sião, desde agora e para sempre.
texts.mic.4.8: E tu, ó torre do rebanho, monte da filha de Sião, até a ti virá; certamente virá o primeiro dominio, o reino da filha de Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.9: Ora porque farias tão grande pranto? não ha em ti rei? pereceu o teu conselheiro? apoderou-se de ti dôr, como da que está de parto?
texts.mic.4.10: Soffre dôres, e trabalhos, para produzir, ó filha de Sião, como a que está de parto, porque agora sairás da cidade, e morarás no campo, e virás até Babylonia: ali, porém, serás livrada; ali te remirá o Senhor da mão de teus inimigos.
texts.mic.4.11: Agora se congregaram muitas nações contra ti, que dizem: Seja profanada, e os nossos olhos verão seus desejos sobre Sião.
texts.mic.4.12: Mas não sabem os pensamentos do Senhor, nem entendem o seu conselho: porque as ajuntou como gavelas á eira.
texts.mic.4.13: Levanta-te, e trilha, ó filha de Sião; porque eu farei de ferro a tua ponta, e de cobre as tuas unhas; e esmiuçarás a muitos povos, e o seu ganho consagrarei ao Senhor, e a sua fazenda ao Senhor de toda a terra.
texts.mic.5.1: Agora ajunta-te com esquadrões, ó filha de esquadrões; pôr-se-ha cerco sobre nós: ferirão com a vara no queixo ao juiz de Israel.
texts.mic.5.2: E tu, Beth-lehem Ephrata, ainda que és pequena entre os milhares de Judah, de ti me sairá o que será Senhor em Israel, e cujas saidas são desde os tempos antigos, desde os dias da eternidade.
texts.mic.5.3: Portanto os entregará até ao tempo em que a que está de parto tiver parido: então o resto de seus irmãos voltará com os filhos de Israel.
texts.mic.5.4: E elle estará em pé, e apascentará ao povo na força do Senhor, na excellencia do nome do Senhor seu Deus: e elles permanecerão, porque agora será engrandecido até aos fins da terra.
texts.mic.5.5: E este será a paz: quando a Assyria vier á nossa terra, e quando passar os nossos palacios, levantaremos contra elle sete pastores e oito principes d’entre os homens.
texts.mic.5.6: Esses consumirão a terra da Assyria á espada, e a terra de Nimrod nas suas entradas. Assim nos livrará da Assyria, quando vier á nossa terra, e quando calcar os nossos termos.
texts.mic.5.7: E estará o resto de Jacob no meio de muitos povos, como orvalho do Senhor, como uns choviscos sobre a terra, que não espera pelo homem, nem aguarda a filhos de homens.
texts.mic.5.8: E o resto de Jacob estará entre as nações, no meio de muitos povos, como um leão entre os animaes do bosque, como um leãosinho entre os rebanhos de ovelhas, o qual, quando passar, pizará e despedaçará, sem que haja quem as livre.
texts.mic.5.9: A tua mão se exaltará sobre os seus adversarios; e todos os teus inimigos serão exterminados.
texts.mic.5.10: E succederá n’aquelle dia, diz o Senhor, que eu exterminarei do meio de ti os teus cavallos, e destruirei os teus carros;
texts.mic.5.11: E destruirei as cidades da tua terra, e derribarei todas as tuas fortalezas;
texts.mic.5.12: E exterminarei as feitiçarias da tua mão: e não terás agoureiros;
texts.mic.5.13: E exterminarei do meio de ti as tuas imagens de esculptura e as tuas estatuas; e tu não te inclinarás mais diante da obra das tuas mãos.
texts.mic.5.14: E arrancarei os teus bosques do meio de ti; e destruirei as tuas cidades.
texts.mic.5.15: E com ira e com furor farei vingança das nações que não ouvem.
texts.mic.6.1: Ouvi agora o que diz o Senhor: Levanta-te, contende com os montes, e ouçam os outeiros a tua voz.
texts.mic.6.2: Ouvi montes, a contenda do Senhor, e vós, fortes fundamentos da terra; porque o Senhor tem uma contenda com o seu povo, e com Israel entrará em juizo.
texts.mic.6.3: Ó povo meu; que te tenho feito? e com que te enfadei? testifica contra mim.
texts.mic.6.4: Certamente te fiz subir da terra do Egypto e da casa da servidão te remi; e enviei adiante de ti a Moysés, Aarão e Miriam.
texts.mic.6.5: Povo meu, ora lembra-te do que consultou Balak, rei de Moab, e o que lhe respondeu Balaão, filho de Beor, desde Sittim até Gilgal; para que conheças as justiças do Senhor.
texts.mic.6.6: Com que coisa encontrarei ao Senhor, e me inclinarei ao Deus altissimo? encontral-o-hei com holocaustos? com bezerros de um anno?
texts.mic.6.7: Agradar-se-ha o Senhor de milhares de carneiros? de dez mil ribeiros de azeite? darei o meu primogenito pela minha transgressão? o fructo do meu ventre pelo peccado da minha alma?
texts.mic.6.8: Elle te declarou, ó homem, o que é bom; e que é o que o Senhor pede de ti, senão que pratiques a justiça, e ames a beneficencia, e andes humildemente com o teu Deus?
texts.mic.6.9: A voz do Senhor clama á cidade (porque o teu nome vê a inteireza): Ouvi a vara, e a quem a ordenou.
texts.mic.6.10: Ainda ha na casa do impio thesouros da impiedade? e epha pequena, que é detestavel?
texts.mic.6.11: Seria eu limpo com balanças falsas? e com uma bolsa de pesos enganosos?
texts.mic.6.12: Porque os seus ricos estão cheios de violencia, e os seus habitantes fallam mentiras; e a sua lingua é enganosa na sua bocca.
texts.mic.6.13: Assim eu tambem te enfraquecerei, ferindo-te e assolando-te por causa dos teus peccados.
texts.mic.6.14: Tu comerás, mas não te fartarás; e a tua humilhação estará no meio de ti; e tu removerás, mas não livrarás; e aquillo que livrares, eu o entregarei á espada.
texts.mic.6.15: Tu semearás, mas não segarás: pisarás a azeitona, mas não te ungirás com azeite; e o mosto, mas não beberás vinho.
texts.mic.6.16: Porque se guardaram os estatutos de Omri, e toda a obra da casa de Acab, e vós andaes nos conselhos d’elles; para que eu te faça uma desolação, e dos seus habitantes um assobio: assim trareis sobre vós o opprobrio do meu povo.
texts.mic.7.1: Ai de mim! porque estou feito como quando se tem colhido as fructas do verão, como os rabiscos da vindima; não ha cacho de uvas para comer; desejou a minha alma figos temporãos.
texts.mic.7.2: Já pereceu o benigno da terra, e não ha entre os homens um que seja recto: todos armam ciladas para sangue; caçam cada um a seu irmão com rede,
texts.mic.7.3: Para com ambas as mãos fazerem diligentemente o mal; assim demanda o principe, e o juiz julga pela recompensa, e o grande falla a corrupção da sua alma, e a torcem.
texts.mic.7.4: O melhor d’elles é como um espinho; o mais recto é peior do que o espinhal: veiu o dia dos teus vigias, veiu a tua visitação; agora será a sua confusão.
texts.mic.7.5: Não creias no amigo, nem confieis no vosso guia, d’aquella que repousa no teu seio guarda as portas da tua bocca.
texts.mic.7.6: Porque o filho despreza ao pae, a filha se levanta contra sua mãe, a nora contra sua sogra, os inimigos do homem são os da sua casa.
texts.mic.7.7: Eu, porém, esperarei no Senhor; esperei no Deus da minha salvação: o meu Deus me ouvirá.
texts.mic.7.8: Ó inimiga minha, não te alegres de mim; ainda bem que eu tenho caido, levantar-me-hei: se morar nas trevas, o Senhor será a minha luz.
texts.mic.7.9: Soffrerei a ira do Senhor, porque pequei contra elle, até que julgue a minha causa, e execute o meu direito: elle tirar-me-ha á luz, verei satisfeito a sua justiça.
texts.mic.7.10: E a minha inimiga o verá, e cobril-a-ha a confusão; e aquella que me diz: Onde está o teu Deus? os meus olhos a verão satisfeitos; agora será ella pisada como a lama das ruas.
texts.mic.7.11: No dia em que reedificar os teus muros, n’esse dia longe estará ainda o estatuto.
texts.mic.7.12: N’aquelle dia virá até ti, desde a Assyria até ás cidades fortes, e das fortalezas até ao rio, e do mar até ao mar, e da montanha até á montanha.
texts.mic.7.13: Porém esta terra será posta em desolação, por causa dos seus moradores, por causa do fructo das suas obras.
texts.mic.7.14: Apascenta o teu povo com a tua vara, o rebanho da tua herança, que móra só no bosque, no meio da terra fertil; apascentem-se em Basan e Gilead, como nos dias da antiguidade.
texts.mic.7.15: Eu lhes mostrarei maravilhas, como nos dias da tua subida da terra do Egypto.
texts.mic.7.16: As nações o verão, e envergonhar-se-hão, por causa de todo o seu poder: porão a mão sobre a bocca, e os seus ouvidos ficarão surdos.
texts.mic.7.17: Lamberão o pó como serpentes, como uns reptis da terra, tremendo, sairão dos seus encerramentos; com pavor virão ao Senhor nosso Deus, e terão medo de ti.
texts.mic.7.18: Quem é Deus similhante a ti, que perdoa a iniquidade, e que passa pela rebellião do restante da sua herança? não retem a sua ira para sempre, porque tem prazer na benignidade.
texts.mic.7.19: Tornará a apiedar-se de nós: sujeitará as nossas iniquidades, e tu lançarás todos os seus peccados nas profundezas do mar.
texts.mic.7.20: Darás a Jacob a fidelidade, e a Abrahão a benignidade, que juraste a nossos paes desde os dias antigos.

texts.mic.1.1: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.2: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
texts.mic.1.3: For behold, the LORD cometh forth from his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
texts.mic.1.4: And the mountains shall be melted under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
texts.mic.1.5: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
texts.mic.1.6: Therefore I will make Samaria as a heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down her stones into the valley, and I will lay bare her foundations.
texts.mic.1.7: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her hires shall be burned with the fire, and all her idols will I lay desolate: for she gathered it from the hire of a harlot, and they shall return to the hire of a harlot.
texts.mic.1.8: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
texts.mic.1.9: For her wound is incurable; for it is come to Judah; he is come to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.10: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
texts.mic.1.11: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame exposed: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive from you his standing.
texts.mic.1.12: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited anxiously for good: but evil came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.13: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
texts.mic.1.14: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
texts.mic.1.15: Yet will I bring an heir to thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come to Adullam the glory of Israel.
texts.mic.1.16: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
texts.mic.2.1: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
texts.mic.2.2: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
texts.mic.2.3: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
texts.mic.2.4: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a grievous lamentation, and say, We are utterly wasted: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
texts.mic.2.5: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
texts.mic.2.6: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
texts.mic.2.7: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
texts.mic.2.8: Even of late my people hath risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse to war.
texts.mic.2.9: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
texts.mic.2.10: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a grievous destruction.
texts.mic.2.11: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood doth lie, saying, I will prophesy to thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
texts.mic.2.12: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
texts.mic.2.13: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and have gone out by it; and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
texts.mic.3.1: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know judgment?
texts.mic.3.2: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from them, and their flesh from off their bones;
texts.mic.3.3: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
texts.mic.3.4: Then shall they cry to the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
texts.mic.3.5: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him:
texts.mic.3.6: Therefore night shall be to you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark to you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
texts.mic.3.7: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yes, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
texts.mic.3.8: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
texts.mic.3.9: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
texts.mic.3.10: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
texts.mic.3.11: Her heads judge for reward, and her priests teach for hire, and her prophets divine for money; yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, Is not the LORD among us? no evil can come upon us.
texts.mic.3.12: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
texts.mic.4.1: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mount of the house of the LORD shall be established on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow to it.
texts.mic.4.2: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.3: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plow-shares, and their spears into pruning-hooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
texts.mic.4.4: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig-tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
texts.mic.4.5: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
texts.mic.4.6: In that day, saith the LORD, I will assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
texts.mic.4.7: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD will reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
texts.mic.4.8: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, to thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come, to the daughter of Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.9: Now why dost thou cry aloud? is there no king in thee? hath thy counselor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
texts.mic.4.10: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth from the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thy enemies.
texts.mic.4.11: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
texts.mic.4.12: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he will gather them as sheaves into the floor.
texts.mic.4.13: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thy horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain to JEHOVAH, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
texts.mic.5.1: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
texts.mic.5.2: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou art little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
texts.mic.5.3: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she who travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return to the children of Israel.
texts.mic.5.4: And he will stand and feed in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now will he be great to the ends of the earth.
texts.mic.5.5: And this man will be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
texts.mic.5.6: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its entrances: thus will he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
texts.mic.5.7: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
texts.mic.5.8: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he goeth through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
texts.mic.5.9: Thy hand shall be lifted up upon thy adversaries, and all thy enemies shall be cut off.
texts.mic.5.10: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
texts.mic.5.11: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
texts.mic.5.12: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thy hand; and thou shalt have no more sooth-sayers:
texts.mic.5.13: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thy hands.
texts.mic.5.14: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
texts.mic.5.15: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
texts.mic.6.1: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
texts.mic.6.2: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD'S controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
texts.mic.6.3: O my people, what have I done to thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me,
texts.mic.6.4: For I brought thee out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee from the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
texts.mic.6.5: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
texts.mic.6.6: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt-offerings, with calves of a year old?
texts.mic.6.7: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my first-born for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
texts.mic.6.8: He hath shown thee, O man, what is good; and what the LORD doth require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
texts.mic.6.9: The LORD'S voice crieth to the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
texts.mic.6.10: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
texts.mic.6.11: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
texts.mic.6.12: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
texts.mic.6.13: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
texts.mic.6.14: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
texts.mic.6.15: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
texts.mic.6.16: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
texts.mic.7.1: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grape-gleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the first ripe fruit.
texts.mic.7.2: The good man hath perished from the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
texts.mic.7.3: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
texts.mic.7.4: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
texts.mic.7.5: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
texts.mic.7.6: For the son dishonoreth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
texts.mic.7.7: Therefore I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
texts.mic.7.8: Rejoice not against me, O my enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
texts.mic.7.9: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he shall plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
texts.mic.7.10: Then she that is my enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her who said to me, Where is the LORD thy God? my eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
texts.mic.7.11: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
texts.mic.7.12: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
texts.mic.7.13: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell in it, for the fruit of their doings.
texts.mic.7.14: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thy heritage, who dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
texts.mic.7.15: According to the days of thy departure from the land of Egypt will I show to him marvelous things.
texts.mic.7.16: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
texts.mic.7.17: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
texts.mic.7.18: Who is a God like to thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
texts.mic.7.19: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
texts.mic.7.20: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

texts.mic.1.1: The word of Jehovah that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.2: Hear, ye peoples, all of you; hearken, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord Jehovah be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple!
texts.mic.1.3: For behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
texts.mic.1.4: And the mountains shall be melted under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, as waters poured down a steep place.
texts.mic.1.5: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. Whence is the transgression of Jacob? is it not [from] Samaria? And whence are the high places of Judah? are they not [from] Jerusalem?
texts.mic.1.6: Therefore will I make Samaria as a heap of the field, as plantings of a vineyard; and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will lay bare the foundations thereof.
texts.mic.1.7: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her harlot-gifts shall be burned with fire, and all her idols will I make a desolation; for of the hire of a harlot hath she gathered [them], and to a harlot's hire shall they return.
texts.mic.1.8: For this will I lament, and I will howl; I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the jackals, and mourning like the ostriches.
texts.mic.1.9: For her wounds are incurable; for it is come even unto Judah, it reacheth unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.10: Tell it not in Gath, weep not at all; at Beth-le-aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
texts.mic.1.11: Pass away, inhabitress of Shaphir, in nakedness [and] shame. The inhabitress of Zaanan is not come forth for the lamentation of Beth-ezel: he will take from you its shelter.
texts.mic.1.12: For the inhabitress of Maroth waited anxiously for good; but evil hath come down from Jehovah unto the gate of Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.13: Bind the chariot to the swift steed, O inhabitress of Lachish: she was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for in thee were found the transgressions of Israel.
texts.mic.1.14: Therefore shalt thou give parting-gifts to Moresheth-Gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
texts.mic.1.15: I will yet bring unto thee an heir, O inhabitress of Mareshah; the glory of Israel shall come even unto Adullam.
texts.mic.1.16: Make thee bald, and poll thee for the children of thy delights; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle, for they are gone into captivity from thee.
texts.mic.2.1: Woe to them that devise iniquity and work evil upon their beds! When the morning is light they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
texts.mic.2.2: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away; and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
texts.mic.2.3: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye walk haughtily: for it is an evil time.
texts.mic.2.4: In that day shall they take up a proverb concerning you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, [and] say, We are utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! He hath distributed our fields to the rebellious.
texts.mic.2.5: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast the measuring line upon a lot, in the congregation of Jehovah.
texts.mic.2.6: Prophesy ye not, they prophesy. If they do not prophesy to these, the ignominy will not depart.
texts.mic.2.7: O thou [that art] named the house of Jacob, Is Jehovah impatient? are these his doings? Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
texts.mic.2.8: But of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye strip off the mantle with the garment from them that pass by securely, that are averse from war.
texts.mic.2.9: The women of my people do ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their young children do ye take away my magnificence for ever.
texts.mic.2.10: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not the resting-place, because of defilement that bringeth destruction, even a grievous destruction.
texts.mic.2.11: If a man walking in wind and falsehood do lie, [saying,] I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink, he shall be the prophet of this people.
texts.mic.2.12: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, the whole of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture: they shall make great noise by reason of [the multitude of] men.
texts.mic.2.13: One that breaketh through is gone up before them: they have broken forth, and have passed on to the gate, and are gone out by it; and their king passeth on before them, and Jehovah at the head of them.
texts.mic.3.1: And I said, Hear, I pray you, ye heads of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know judgment?
texts.mic.3.2: Ye who hate the good, and love evil; who pluck off their skin from them, and their flesh from off their bones;
texts.mic.3.3: and who eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces as for the pot, and as flesh within the cauldron.
texts.mic.3.4: Then shall they cry unto Jehovah, but he will not answer them; and he will hide his face from them at that time, according as they have wrought evil in their doings.
texts.mic.3.5: Thus saith Jehovah concerning the prophets that cause my people to err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace! but whoso putteth not into their mouths they prepare war against him:
texts.mic.3.6: therefore ye shall have night without a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, without divination; and the sun shall go down upon the prophets, and the day shall be black over them.
texts.mic.3.7: And the seers shall be ashamed, and the diviners confounded; and they shall all cover their lips, for there will be no answer of God.
texts.mic.3.8: But truly I am filled with power by the Spirit of Jehovah, and with judgment and with might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
texts.mic.3.9: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity,
texts.mic.3.10: that build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with unrighteousness.
texts.mic.3.11: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money; yet do they lean upon Jehovah, and say, Is not Jehovah in the midst of us? no evil shall come upon us.
texts.mic.3.12: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be ploughed [as] a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
texts.mic.4.1: But it shall come to pass in the end of days [that] the mountain of Jehovah's house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be lifted up above the hills; and the peoples shall flow unto it.
texts.mic.4.2: And many nations shall go and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths. For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and Jehovah's word from Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.3: And he shall judge among many peoples, and reprove strong nations, even afar off; and they shall forge their swords into ploughshares, and their spears into pruning-knives: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
texts.mic.4.4: And they shall sit every one under his vine, and under his fig-tree; and there shall be none to make [them] afraid: for the mouth of Jehovah of hosts hath spoken [it].
texts.mic.4.5: For all the peoples will walk every one in the name of his god; but we will walk in the name of Jehovah, our God for ever and ever.
texts.mic.4.6: In that day, saith Jehovah, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
texts.mic.4.7: and I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation; and Jehovah shall reign over them in mount Zion, from henceforth even for ever.
texts.mic.4.8: And thou, O tower of the flock, hill of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, yea, the first dominion shall come, -- the kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.9: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished, that pangs have seized thee as a woman in travail?
texts.mic.4.10: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon: there shalt thou be delivered; there Jehovah will redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
texts.mic.4.11: And now many nations are assembled against thee, that say, Let her be profaned, and let our eye look upon Zion.
texts.mic.4.12: But they know not the thoughts of Jehovah, neither understand they his counsel; for he hath gathered them together as the sheaves into the threshing-floor.
texts.mic.4.13: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make thy horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass; and thou shalt beat in pieces many peoples; and I will devote their gain to Jehovah, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
texts.mic.5.1: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops; he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
texts.mic.5.2: (And thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, little to be among the thousands of Judah, out of thee shall he come forth unto me [who is] to be Ruler in Israel: whose goings forth are from of old, from the days of eternity.)
texts.mic.5.3: Therefore will he give them up, until the time when she which travaileth shall have brought forth: and the residue of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
texts.mic.5.4: And he shall stand and feed [his flock] in the strength of Jehovah, in the majesty of the name of Jehovah his God. And they shall abide; for now shall he be great even unto the ends of the earth.
texts.mic.5.5: And this [man] shall be Peace. When the Assyrian shall come into our land, and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight princes of men.
texts.mic.5.6: And they shall waste the land of Asshur with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof; and he shall deliver [us] from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
texts.mic.5.7: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples as dew from Jehovah, as showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, neither waiteth for the sons of men.
texts.mic.5.8: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and there is none to deliver.
texts.mic.5.9: Thy hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
texts.mic.5.10: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith Jehovah, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots.
texts.mic.5.11: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and overthrow all thy strongholds.
texts.mic.5.12: And I will cut off sorceries out of thy hand; and thou shalt have no soothsayers.
texts.mic.5.13: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy statues out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more bow down to the work of thy hands.
texts.mic.5.14: And I will pluck up thine Asherahs out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy cities.
texts.mic.5.15: And I will execute vengeance in anger and in fury upon the nations, such as they have not heard of.
texts.mic.6.1: Hear ye now what Jehovah saith: Arise, contend before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
texts.mic.6.2: Hear, ye mountains, Jehovah's controversy, and ye, unchanging foundations of the earth; for Jehovah hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
texts.mic.6.3: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
texts.mic.6.4: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of bondage; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
texts.mic.6.5: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him, from Shittim unto Gilgal, that ye may know the righteousness of Jehovah.
texts.mic.6.6: Wherewith shall I come before Jehovah, bow myself before the high God? Shall I come before him with burnt-offerings, with calves of a year old?
texts.mic.6.7: Will Jehovah take pleasure in thousands of rams, in ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
texts.mic.6.8: He hath shewn thee, O man, what is good: and what doth Jehovah require of thee, but to do justly, and to love goodness, and to walk humbly with thy God?
texts.mic.6.9: Jehovah's voice crieth unto the city, and wisdom looketh on thy name. Hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
texts.mic.6.10: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure [which is] abominable?
texts.mic.6.11: Shall I be pure with the unjust balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
texts.mic.6.12: For her rich men are full of violence, and her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
texts.mic.6.13: Therefore also will I make [thee] sick in smiting thee; I will make [thee] desolate because of thy sins.
texts.mic.6.14: Thou shalt eat, and not be satisfied, and thine emptiness [shall remain] in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take away, and not save; and what thou savest will I give up to the sword.
texts.mic.6.15: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and new wine, but shalt not drink wine.
texts.mic.6.16: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab; and ye walk in their counsels: that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof a hissing; and ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
texts.mic.7.1: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer-fruits, as the grape-gleanings of the vintage. There is no cluster to eat; there is no early fruit [which] my soul desired.
texts.mic.7.2: The godly [man] hath perished out of the land, and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood, they hunt every man his brother with a net.
texts.mic.7.3: Both hands are for evil, to do it well. The prince asketh, and the judge [is there] for a reward; and the great [man] uttereth his soul's greed: and [together] they combine it.
texts.mic.7.4: The best of them is as a briar; the most upright, [worse] than a thorn-fence. The day of thy watchmen, thy visitation is come; now shall be their perplexity.
texts.mic.7.5: Believe ye not in a companion, put not confidence in a familiar friend: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
texts.mic.7.6: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law: a man's enemies are the men of his own household.
texts.mic.7.7: But as for me, I will look unto Jehovah; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
texts.mic.7.8: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: though I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, Jehovah shall be a light unto me.
texts.mic.7.9: I will bear the indignation of Jehovah -- for I have sinned against him -- until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light; I shall behold his righteousness.
texts.mic.7.10: And mine enemy shall see [it], and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is Jehovah thy God? Mine eyes shall behold her; now shall she be trodden down, as the mire of the streets.
texts.mic.7.11: In the day when thy walls shall be built, on that day shall the established limit recede.
texts.mic.7.12: In that day they shall come to thee from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
texts.mic.7.13: But the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
texts.mic.7.14: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine inheritance, dwelling alone in the forest, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
texts.mic.7.15: -- As in the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt, will I shew them marvellous things.
texts.mic.7.16: -- The nations shall see, and be ashamed for all their might: they shall lay [their] hand upon [their] mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
texts.mic.7.17: They shall lick dust like the serpent; like crawling things of the earth, they shall come trembling forth from their close places. They shall turn with fear to Jehovah our God, and shall be afraid because of thee.
texts.mic.7.18: Who is a ùGod like unto thee, that forgiveth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? He retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in loving-kindness.
texts.mic.7.19: He will yet again have compassion on us, he will tread under foot our iniquities: and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
texts.mic.7.20: Thou wilt perform truth to Jacob, loving-kindness to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers, from the days of old.

texts.mic.1.1: A word of Jehovah that hath been unto Micah the Morashite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, that he hath seen concerning Samaria and Jerusalem:
texts.mic.1.2: Hear, O peoples, all of them! Attend, O earth, and its fulness, And the Lord Jehovah is against you for a witness, The Lord from His holy temple.
texts.mic.1.3: For lo, Jehovah is going out from His place, And He hath come down, And hath trodden on high places of earth.
texts.mic.1.4: Melted have been the mountains under Him, And the valleys do rend themselves, As wax from the presence of fire, As waters cast down by a slope.
texts.mic.1.5: For the transgression of Jacob [is] all this, And for the sins of the house of Israel. What [is] the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what the high places of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
texts.mic.1.6: And I have set Samaria for a heap of the field, For plantations of a vineyard, And poured out into a valley her stones, And her foundations I uncover.
texts.mic.1.7: And all her graven images are beaten down, And all her gifts are burnt with fire, And all her idols I make a desolation, For, from the hire of a harlot she gathered, and unto the hire of a harlot they return.
texts.mic.1.8: For this I lament and howl, I go spoiled and naked, I make a lamentation like dragons, And a mourning like daughters of an ostrich.
texts.mic.1.9: For mortal [are] her wounds, For it hath come unto Judah, It hath come to a gate of My people -- to Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.10: In Gath tell ye not -- in Acco weep not, In Beth-Aphrah, in dust roll thyself.
texts.mic.1.11: Pass over for thee, O inhabitant of Shaphir, Naked one of shame. Not gone out hath the inhabitant of Zaanan, The lamentation of Beth-Ezel doth take from you its standing.
texts.mic.1.12: For stayed for good hath the inhabitant of Maroth, For evil hath come down from Jehovah to the gate of Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.13: Bind the chariot to a swift beast, O inhabitant of Lachish, The beginning of sin [is] she to the daughter of Zion, For in thee have been found the transgressions of Israel.
texts.mic.1.14: Therefore thou givest presents to Moresheth-Gath, The houses of Achzib become a lying thing to the kings of Israel.
texts.mic.1.15: Yet the possessor I do bring in to thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah, To Adullam come in doth the honour of Israel.
texts.mic.1.16: Make bald and shave, for thy delightful sons, Enlarge thy baldness as an eagle, For they have removed from thee!
texts.mic.2.1: Wo [to] those devising iniquity, And working evil on their beds, In the light of the morning they do it, For their hand is -- to God.
texts.mic.2.2: And they have desired fields, And they have taken violently, And houses, and they have taken away, And have oppressed a man and his house, Even a man and his inheritance.
texts.mic.2.3: Therefore, thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am devising against this family evil, From which ye do not remove your necks, Nor walk loftily, for a time of evil it [is].
texts.mic.2.4: In that day doth [one] take up for you a simile, And he hath wailed a wailing of wo, He hath said, We have been utterly spoiled, The portion of my people He doth change, How doth He move toward me! To the backslider our fields He apportioneth.
texts.mic.2.5: Therefore, thou hast no caster of a line by lot In the assembly of Jehovah.
texts.mic.2.6: Ye do not prophesy -- they do prophesy, They do not prophesy to these, It doth not remove shame.
texts.mic.2.7: Doth the house of Jacob say, `Hath the Spirit of Jehovah been shortened? Are these His doings?' Do not My words benefit the people that is walking uprightly?
texts.mic.2.8: And yesterday My people for an enemy doth raise himself up, From the outer garment the honourable ornament ye strip off, From the confident passers by, Ye who are turning back from war.
texts.mic.2.9: The women of My people ye cast out from its delightful house, From its sucklings ye take away My honour to the age.
texts.mic.2.10: Rise and go, for this [is] not the rest, Because of uncleanness it doth corrupt, And corruption is powerful.
texts.mic.2.11: If one is going [with] the wind, And [with] falsehood hath lied: `I prophesy to thee of wine, and of strong drink,' He hath been the prophet of this people!
texts.mic.2.12: I do surely gather thee, O Jacob, all of thee, I surely bring together the remnant of Israel, Together I do set it as the flock of Bozrah, As a drove in the midst of its pasture, It maketh a noise because of man.
texts.mic.2.13: Gone up hath the breaker before them, They have broken through, Yea, they pass through the gate, Yea, they go out through it, And pass on doth their king before them, And Jehovah at their head!
texts.mic.3.1: And I say, `Hear, I pray you, heads of Jacob, And ye judges of the house of Israel, Is it not for you to know the judgment?
texts.mic.3.2: Ye who are hating good, and loving evil, Taking violently their skin from off them, And their flesh from off their bones,
texts.mic.3.3: And who have eaten the flesh of My people, And their skin from off them have stript, And their bones they have broken, And they have spread [them] out as in a pot, And as flesh in the midst of a caldron.
texts.mic.3.4: Then do they cry unto Jehovah, And He doth not answer them, And hideth His face from them at that time, As they have made evil their doings.
texts.mic.3.5: Thus said Jehovah concerning the prophets Who are causing My people to err, Who are biting with their teeth, And have cried `Peace,' And he who doth not give unto their mouth, They have sanctified against him war.
texts.mic.3.6: Therefore a night ye have without vision, And darkness ye have without divination, And gone in hath the sun on the prophets, And black over them hath been the day.
texts.mic.3.7: And ashamed have been the seers, And confounded have been the diviners, And covered their lip have all of them, For their is no answer, O God.
texts.mic.3.8: And yet I have been full of power by the Spirit of Jehovah, And of judgment, and of might, To declare to Jacob his transgression, And to Israel his sin.
texts.mic.3.9: Hear this, I pray you, heads of the house of Jacob, And ye judges of the house of Israel, Who are making judgment abominable, And all uprightness do pervert.
texts.mic.3.10: Building up Zion with blood, And Jerusalem with iniquity.
texts.mic.3.11: Her heads for a bribe do judge, And her priests for hire do teach, And her prophets for silver divine, And on Jehovah they lean, saying, `Is not Jehovah in our midst? Evil doth not come in upon us.'
texts.mic.3.12: Therefore, for your sake, Zion is ploughed a field, and Jerusalem is heaps, And the mount of the house [is] for high places of a forest!
texts.mic.4.1: And it hath come to pass, In the latter end of the days, The mount of the house of Jehovah Is established above the top of the mounts, And it hath been lifted up above the hills, And flowed unto it have peoples.
texts.mic.4.2: And gone have many nations and said, Come and we go up to the mount of Jehovah, And unto the house of the God of Jacob, And He doth teach us of His ways, And we do walk in His paths, For from Zion doth go forth a law, And a word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.3: And He hath judged between many peoples, And given a decision to mighty nations afar off, They have beaten their swords to ploughshares, And their spears to pruning-hooks, Nation lifteth not up sword unto nation, Nor do they learn war any more.
texts.mic.4.4: And they have sat each under his vine, And under his fig-tree, And there is none troubling, For the mouth of Jehovah of Hosts hath spoken.
texts.mic.4.5: For all the peoples do walk, Each in the name of its god -- and we, We do walk in the name of Jehovah our God, To the age and for ever.
texts.mic.4.6: In that day -- an affirmation of Jehovah, I do gather the halting one, And the driven away one I bring together, And she whom I have afflicted.
texts.mic.4.7: And I have set the halting for a remnant, And the far-off for a mighty nation, And reigned hath Jehovah over them in mount Zion, From henceforth, and unto the age.
texts.mic.4.8: And thou, O tower of Eder, Fort of the daughter of Zion, unto thee it cometh, Yea, come in hath the former rule, The kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem.
texts.mic.4.9: Now, why dost thou shout aloud? A king -- is there none in thee? Hath thy counsellor perished, That taken hold of thee hath pain as a travailing woman?
texts.mic.4.10: Be pained, and bring forth, O daughter of Zion, As a travailing woman, For now, thou goest forth from the city, And thou hast dwelt in the field, And thou hast gone unto Babylon, There thou art delivered, There redeem thee doth Jehovah from the hand of thine enemies.
texts.mic.4.11: And now, gathered against thee have been many nations, who are saying: `Let her be defiled, and our eyes look on Zion.'
texts.mic.4.12: They have not known the thoughts of Jehovah, Nor have they understood His counsel, For He hath gathered them as a sheaf [into] a threshing-floor.
texts.mic.4.13: Arise, and thresh, O daughter of Zion, For thy horn I make iron, And thy hoofs I make brass, And thou hast beaten small many peoples, And I have devoted to Jehovah their gain, And their wealth to the Lord of the whole earth!
texts.mic.5.1: Now gather thyself together, O daughter of troops, A siege he hath laid against us, With a rod they smite on the cheek the judge of Israel.
texts.mic.5.2: And thou, Beth-Lehem Ephratah, Little to be among the chiefs of Judah! From thee to Me he cometh forth -- to be ruler in Israel, And his comings forth [are] of old, From the days of antiquity.
texts.mic.5.3: Therefore he doth give them out till the time She who bringeth forth hath brought forth, And the remnant of his brethren return to the sons of Israel.
texts.mic.5.4: And he hath stood and delighted in the strength of Jehovah, In the excellency of the name of Jehovah his God, And they have remained, For now he is great unto the ends of earth.
texts.mic.5.5: And this [one] hath been peace, Asshur! when he doth come into our land, And when he doth tread in our palaces, We have raised against him seven shepherds, And eight anointed of man.
texts.mic.5.6: And they have afflicted the land of Asshur with the sword, And the land of Nimrod at its openings, And he hath delivered from Asshur when he doth come into our land, And when he treadeth in our borders.
texts.mic.5.7: And the remnant of Jacob hath been in the midst of many peoples, As dew from Jehovah -- as showers on the herb, That waiteth not for man, nor stayeth for the sons of men.
texts.mic.5.8: Yea, the remnant of Jacob hath been among nations, In the midst of many peoples, As a lion among beasts of a forest, As a young lion among ranks of a flock, Which if it hath passed through, Hath both trodden down and hath torn, And there is no deliverer.
texts.mic.5.9: High is thy hand above thine adversaries, And all thine enemies are cut off.
texts.mic.5.10: And it hath come to pass in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah, I have cut off thy horses from thy midst, And I have destroyed thy chariots,
texts.mic.5.11: And I have cut off the cities of thy land, And I have thrown down all thy fortresses,
texts.mic.5.12: And have cut off sorcerers out of thy hand, And observers of clouds thou hast none.
texts.mic.5.13: And I have cut off thy graven images, And thy standing-pillars out of thy midst, And thou dost not bow thyself any more To the work of thy hands.
texts.mic.5.14: And I have plucked up thy shrines out of thy midst, And I have destroyed thine enemies.
texts.mic.5.15: And I have done vengeance in anger and in fury, With the nations who have not hearkened!
texts.mic.6.1: Hear, I pray you, that which Jehovah is saying: `Rise -- strive thou with the mountains, And cause thou the hills to hear thy voice.'
texts.mic.6.2: Hear, O mountains, the strife of Jehovah, Ye strong ones -- foundations of earth! For a strife [is] to Jehovah, with His people, And with Israel He doth reason.
texts.mic.6.3: O My people, what have I done to thee? And what -- have I wearied thee? Testify against Me.
texts.mic.6.4: For I brought thee up from the land of Egypt, And from the house of servants I have ransomed thee, And I send before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
texts.mic.6.5: O My people, remember, I pray you, What counsel did Balak king of Moab, What answer him did Balaam son of Beor, (From Shittim unto Gilgal,) In order to know the righteous acts of Jehovah.'
texts.mic.6.6: With what do I come before Jehovah? Do I bow to God Most High? Do I come before Him with burnt-offerings? With calves -- sons of a year?
texts.mic.6.7: Is Jehovah pleased with thousands of rams? With myriads of streams of oil? Do I give my first-born [for] my transgression? The fruit of my body [for] the sin of my soul?
texts.mic.6.8: He hath declared to thee, O man, what [is] good; Yea, what is Jehovah requiring of thee, Except -- to do judgment, and love kindness, And lowly to walk with thy God?
texts.mic.6.9: A voice of Jehovah to the city calleth, And wisdom doth fear Thy name, Hear ye the rod, and Him who appointed it.
texts.mic.6.10: Are there yet [in] the house of the wicked Treasures of wickedness, And the abhorred scanty ephah?
texts.mic.6.11: Do I reckon [it] pure with balances of wickedness? And with a bag of deceitful stones?
texts.mic.6.12: Whose rich ones have been full of violence, And its inhabitants have spoken falsehood, And their tongue [is] deceitful in their mouth.
texts.mic.6.13: And I also, I have begun to smite thee, To make desolate, because of thy sins.
texts.mic.6.14: Thou -- thou eatest, and thou art not satisfied, And thy pit [is] in thy midst, And thou removest, and dost not deliver, And that which thou deliverest, to a sword I give.
texts.mic.6.15: Thou -- thou sowest, and thou dost not reap, Thou -- thou treadest the olive, And thou pourest not out oil, And new wine -- and thou drinkest not wine.
texts.mic.6.16: And kept habitually are the statutes of Omri, And all the work of the house of Ahab, And ye do walk in their counsels, For My giving thee for a desolation, And its inhabitants for a hissing, And the reproach of My people ye do bear!
texts.mic.7.1: My wo [is] to me, for I have been As gatherings of summer-fruit, As gleanings of harvest, There is no cluster to eat, The first-ripe fruit desired hath my soul.
texts.mic.7.2: Perished hath the kind out of the land, And upright among men -- there are none, All of them for blood lie in wait, Each his brother they hunt [with] a net.
texts.mic.7.3: On the evil [are] both hands to do [it] well, The prince is asking -- also the judge -- for recompence, And the great -- he is speaking the mischief of his soul, And they wrap it up.
texts.mic.7.4: Their best one [is] as a brier, The upright one -- than a thorn-hedge, The day of thy watchmen -- Thy visitation -- hath come. Now is their perplexity.
texts.mic.7.5: Believe not in a friend, trust not in a leader, From her who is lying in thy bosom keep the openings of thy mouth.
texts.mic.7.6: For a son is dishonouring a father, A daughter hath stood against her mother, A daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law, The enemies of each [are] the men of his house.
texts.mic.7.7: And I -- in Jehovah I do watch, I do wait for the God of my salvation, Hear me doth my God.
texts.mic.7.8: Thou dost not rejoice over me, O mine enemy, When I have fallen, I have risen, When I sit in darkness Jehovah is a light to me.
texts.mic.7.9: The indignation of Jehovah I do bear, For I have sinned against Him, Till that He doth plead my cause, And hath executed my judgment, He doth bring me forth to the light, I look on His righteousness.
texts.mic.7.10: And see doth mine enemy, And cover her doth shame, Who saith unto me, `Where [is] Jehovah thy God?' Mine eyes do look on her, Now she is for a treading-place, As mire of the out-places.
texts.mic.7.11: The day to build thy walls! That day -- removed is the limit.
texts.mic.7.12: That day -- even unto thee it doth come in, From Asshur and the cities of the fortress, And from the fortress even unto the river, And from sea to sea, and mount to mount.
texts.mic.7.13: And the land hath been for a desolation, Because of its inhabitants, Because of the fruit of their doings.
texts.mic.7.14: Rule Thou Thy people with Thy rod, The flock of Thine inheritance, Dwelling alone [in] a forest in the midst of Carmel, They enjoy Bashan and Gilead as in days of old.
texts.mic.7.15: According to the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt, I do shew it wonderful things.
texts.mic.7.16: See do nations, and they are ashamed of all their might, They lay a hand on the mouth, their ears are deaf.
texts.mic.7.17: They lick dust as a serpent, as fearful things of earth, They tremble from their enclosures, Of Jehovah our God they are afraid, Yea, they are afraid of Thee.
texts.mic.7.18: Who [is] a God like Thee? taking away iniquity, And passing by the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance, He hath not retained for ever His anger, Because He -- He delighteth [in] kindness.
texts.mic.7.19: He doth turn back, He pitieth us, He doth subdue our iniquities, And Thou castest into the depths of the sea all their sins.
texts.mic.7.20: Thou givest truth to Jacob, kindness to Abraham, That thou hast sworn to our fathers, from the days of antiquity!

texts.mic.1.1: Palabra de Jehová que fue a Miquéas de Morasti en días de Joatán, Acaz, y Ezequías, reyes de Judá: lo que vio sobre Samaria, y Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.2: Oíd todos los pueblos: tierra, y todo lo que en ella hay, está atenta; y el Señor Jehová, el Señor desde su santo templo sea testigo contra vosotros.
texts.mic.1.3: Porque he aquí que Jehová sale de su lugar, y descenderá, y hollará sobre las alturas de la tierra.
texts.mic.1.4: Y debajo de él se derretirán los montes, y los valles se henderán, como la cera delante del fuego, y como las aguas que corren cuesta abajo.
texts.mic.1.5: Todo esto por la rebelión de Jacob, y por los pecados de la casa de Israel. ¿Qué es la rebelión de Jacob? ¿No es Samaria? ¿Y cuales son los excelsos de Judá? ¿No es Jerusalem?
texts.mic.1.6: Pondré pues a Samaria en majanos de heredad, en tierras de viñas; y derramaré sus piedras por el valle, y descubriré sus fundamentos.
texts.mic.1.7: Y todas sus esculturas serán quebradas, y todos sus dones serán quemados en fuego; y asolaré todos sus ídolos; porque de dones de rameras se juntó, y a dones de rameras volverán.
texts.mic.1.8: Por tanto lamentaré, y aullaré: andaré despojado, y desnudo; y haré llanto como de dragones, y lamentación como de los hijos del avestruz.
texts.mic.1.9: Porque su llaga es dolorosa, que llegó hasta Judá: llegó hasta la puerta de mi pueblo, hasta Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.10: No lo digáis en Get, ni lloréis mucho: revuélcate en el polvo por Betafra.
texts.mic.1.11: Pásate desnuda con vergüenza, o! moradora de Safir: la moradora de Saanán no salió al llanto de Bet-haesel: tomará de vosotros su tardanza.
texts.mic.1.12: Porque la moradora de Marot tuvo dolor por el bien; porque el mal descendió de Jehová hasta la puerta de Jerusalem.
texts.mic.1.13: Unce al carro dromedarios, o! moradora de Laquis, que fuiste principio de pecado a la hija de Sión; porque en ti se inventaron las rebeliones de Israel.
texts.mic.1.14: Por tanto tú darás dones a Mareset en Get: las casas de Aczib serán en mentira a los reyes de Israel.
texts.mic.1.15: Aun te traeré heredero, o! moradora de Maresa: la gloria de Israel vendrá hasta Odollam.
texts.mic.1.16: Mésate, y trasquílate por los hijos de tus delicias: ensancha tu calva como águila; porque fueron trasportados de ti.
texts.mic.2.1: ¡Ay de los que piensan iniquidad, y de los que fabrican el mal en sus camas! y cuando viene la mañana lo ponen en obra, porque tienen en su mano el poder.
texts.mic.2.2: Y codiciaron las heredades, y las robaron: y casas, y las tomaron: oprimieron al hombre y a su casa, al hombre y a su heredad.
texts.mic.2.3: Por tanto así dijo Jehová: He aquí que yo pienso mal sobre esta familia, del cual no sacaréis vuestros cuellos, ni andaréis enhiestos, porque el tiempo será malo.
texts.mic.2.4: En aquel tiempo se levantará sobre vosotros refrán, y se endechará endecha de lamentación, diciendo: Del todo fuimos destruidos: trocó la parte de mi pueblo: ¡cómo nos quitó nuestros campos! dio, los repartió a otros.
texts.mic.2.5: Por tanto no tendrás quien eche cordel para suerte en la congregación de Jehová.
texts.mic.2.6: No profeticéis, los que profetizáis, no les profeticen que los ha de comprender vergüenza.
texts.mic.2.7: La que te dices, casa de Jacob: ¿Háse acortado el Espíritu de Jehová? ¿son estas sus obras? ¿Mis palabras no hacen bien al que camina derechamente?
texts.mic.2.8: El que ayer era mi pueblo se ha levantado como enemigo tras la vestidura: quitasteis las capas atrevidamente a los que pasaban, como los que vuelven de la guerra.
texts.mic.2.9: A las mujeres de mi pueblo echasteis fuera de las casas de sus deleites: a sus niños quitasteis mi perpetua alabanza.
texts.mic.2.10: Levantáos, y andád: que no es esta la holganza; porque está contaminada, corrompióse, y de grande corrupción.
texts.mic.2.11: Si hubiere alguno que ande con el viento, y mienta mentiras, diciendo: Yo te profetizaré, por vino, y por sidra: este tal será profeta a este pueblo.
texts.mic.2.12: ¶ Juntando te juntaré todo, o! Jacob: recogiendo recogeré la resta de Israel: ponerle he junto como ovejas de Bosra, como rebaño en mitad de su majada: harán estruendo por la multitud de los hombres.
texts.mic.2.13: Subirá rompedor delante de ellos: romperán, y pasarán la puerta, y saldrán por ella; y su rey pasará delante de ellos, Jehová por su cabeza.
texts.mic.3.1: Y dije: Oíd ahora, príncipes de Jacob, y cabezas de la casa de Israel: ¿No pertenecía a vosotros saber el derecho?
texts.mic.3.2: Que aborrecen lo bueno, y aman lo malo: que les roban su cuero, y su carne de sobre sus huesos.
texts.mic.3.3: Y que comen la carne de mi pueblo, y les desuellan su cuero de sobre ellos, y les quebrantan sus huesos, y los rompen como para echar en caldero, y como carnes en olla.
texts.mic.3.4: Entonces clamarán a Jehová, y no les responderá: antes esconderá de ellos su rostro en aquel tiempo, como ellos hicieron malas obras.
texts.mic.3.5: Así dijo Jehová de los profetas, que hacen errar mi pueblo, que muerden con sus dientes, y claman paz; y al que no les diere que coman, aplazan contra él batalla.
texts.mic.3.6: Por tanto de la profecía se os hará noche, y oscuridad del adivinar; y sobre estos profetas se pondrá el sol, y el día se entenebrecerá sobre ellos.
texts.mic.3.7: Y avergonzarse han los profetas, y confundirse han los adivinos, y ellos todos cubrirán su labio; porque no tendrán respuesta de Dios.
texts.mic.3.8: Yo empero soy lleno de fuerza del Espíritu de Jehová, y de juicio, y de fortaleza; para denunciar a Jacob su rebelión, y a Israel su pecado.
texts.mic.3.9: Oíd ahora esto, cabezas de la casa de Jacob, y capitanes de la casa de Israel, que abomináis el juicio, y pervertís todo el derecho:
texts.mic.3.10: Que edificáis a Sión con sangre, y a Jerusalem con injusticia:
texts.mic.3.11: Sus cabezas juzgan por cohecho, y sus sacerdotes enseñan por precio, y sus profetas adivinan por dinero; y arrímanse a Jehová, diciendo: ¿No está Jehová entre nosotros? No vendrá mal sobre nosotros.
texts.mic.3.12: Por tanto a causa de vosotros Sión será arada como campo, y Jerusalem será majanos, y el monte de la casa como cumbres de breña.
texts.mic.4.1: Y acontecerá en los postreros tiempos, que el monte de la casa de Jehová será constituido por cabecera de montes, y más alto que todos los collados, y correrán a él pueblos.
texts.mic.4.2: Y vendrán muchas naciones, y dirán: Veníd, y subamos al monte de Jehová, y a la casa del Dios de Jacob; y enseñarnos ha en sus caminos, y andaremos por sus veredas, porque de Sión saldrá la ley, y de Jerusalem la palabra de Jehová.
texts.mic.4.3: Y juzgará entre muchos pueblos, y corregirá a fuertes naciones hasta muy lejos; y martillarán sus espadas para azadones, y sus lanzas para hoces: no alzará espada nación contra nación, ni más se ensayarán para la guerra.
texts.mic.4.4: Y cada uno se sentará debajo de su vid, y debajo de su higuera, y no habrá quien amedrente; porque la boca de Jehová de los ejércitos habló.
